note: Issue #609: NPCs who drive a speeder. Read by src/systems/ai/speeder_brain.gd (SpeederBrain: how they drive) and src/systems/vehicles/speeder_node.gd (getting on and off). A driver drives the same speeder and HoverModel as the player (content/core/vehicles/speeder.json); only how well is set here. `skills` are blocks over `default` (pro: the far side's race crews, the best on the planet, a little sharper than ace and looking further ahead for rocks): steer_gain (how hard it steers for an angle), point_reach (m: a point counts as passed this close), brake_time (s of speed ahead it starts slowing for the next turn), corner_slow (0..1: how much a sharp turn slows it), min_corner (the least share of top speed it keeps for any turn), boost (0..1: the chance each half second it is willing to boost), boost_angle_deg and boost_dist (m: only nearly straight on and this far out), wander_m (m it wanders off the line), look_min and look_ahead_s (how far ahead it looks for walls: m plus s of speed), avoid_margin (m kept round things to avoid), hold_range (m a pursuer holds behind its target), lead_s (s it leads a moving target), fire_cone_deg (it fires when the target is this close to its nose), park_reach (m) and park_face_deg. Issue #853, on a race track (SpeederBrain.follow_track): track_look_s (s of speed it aims ahead along the track, at least point_reach m), track_turn_pts (points either side a turn is measured over), track_brake_use (the share of the speeder's brake it plans to use for the turns ahead: less than all of it, since in the air off a crest it can not brake), track_corner_m and track_corner_max_m (m it lets a turn bend out from the corner, by rock and on open sand: the track's room from just before the corner to track_corner_pts points after it picks between them; with the speeder's own turn rate this sets how fast it takes each turn, and it never boosts into one it can not brake for) and track_min_speed (m/s: the slowest it takes any turn), track_chord_m (it aims nearer where its straight line to the aim point would leave the track by more than the track's room there, RaceCourse.track_room, and never by more than this where there is none), track_room_ahead_s (it counts as off its track once it is further from it than the track's room over this many seconds of driving ahead: slowed, no boost, rock swerve back on), track_off_m (within this of that it trusts it and makes no rock swerve), track_avoid (how hard it steers round other speeders on a track, a share of off it), track_rejoin (how many points ahead it looks for a nearer stretch after being knocked off). Issue #883: heist_chaser, the getaway chaser after a heist (SpeederBrain.harass): it boosts only on the ram (boost is its chance), so a player who boosts gets away; fire_cone_deg wide and harass_wobble_m (m its nose sways either side while it tails you) so most bolts miss; harass_ram_m (m: close enough counts as the ram) and harass_ram_s, harass_tail_m and harass_tail_s, harass_pass_ahead_m and harass_pass_side_m (where it aims to go by you), harass_pass_m (m ahead of you: passed) and harass_pass_s, harass_drop_pace (the share of your speed it eases to) with harass_drop_m (m behind you: back on your tail) and harass_drop_s; each _s gives the phase up and moves on. wave_rush: the speeder wave on a heist, coming in at full boost and pulling up by the door. valet: a speeder you called driving itself to you, nobody aboard (SpeederPost.call_speeder): on the line, no wandering. `rules` apply to every driver: stuck_s and backoff_s (pressing on without moving this long: back off this long), board_timeout_s (gives up walking to a speeder), thrown_damage (hp a rider loses when the speeder bursts under them; never lethal).
